plan: My value is $48, which is very high. Other bidders' values are randomly drawn between $0-$49. To maximize profit, I want to win without overpaying. A dominant strategy is to bid slightly less than my true value. Since this is a second-price auction, I'll bid strategically to ensure winning while minimizing my payment. I'll bid close to, but not exactly at, my true value to leave some potential profit margin.

With a private value of $38, I want to maximize potential profit. Since values are randomly drawn between $0-$49, rational bidders will likely bid strategically below their true value. I'll aim to bid slightly above the expected median bid (around $24.50) but below my true value. A bid around $35 gives me room to potentially win while protecting downside risk. This allows profit if I win and minimizes loss if I don't.

With a private value of $12, my goal is to maximize potential profit. Since values are randomly drawn between $0-$49, rational bidders will likely bid strategically near their true value. A pure dominant strategy is impossible, so I'll bid slightly above my value to increase winning chances. I'll aim to bid around $15-$16 - high enough to potentially win, but not so high that I risk significant loss if I win but pay more than my value.
